en-US.title: "Never Give Up, Either"... Teachers Who Overcame Disabilities to Stand in the Classroom [MBN News 7]
en-US.description:
【 Anchor Comment 】

The proportion of teachers with disabilities in Korea is in the 1% range.

Standing on the podium is by no means an easy task, especially when facing prejudice due to a disability.

Today (the 15th), in celebration of Teachers' Day, Reporter Choi Hee-ji met with teachers with disabilities who have overcome their challenges to convey hope to their students.

【 Reporter 】

As class draws to a close, students gather at the podium.

There is no sense of distance in the way they converse.

Teacher Kim Han-eum, known as a friendly teacher, has a congenital physical disability, having been born with four fingers on each hand and three toes.

Although he now gets along with his students like a friend, it wasn't easy from the start.

▶ Interview: Kim Han-eum / Teacher with Grade 3 Physical Disability

- "There are times when they look at me as if I look somewhat alien. I think I was quite flustered at first when I received questions related to my disability."

The way he overcame these difficulties was by openly revealing his disability without hiding it.

Afterwards, they naturally began sharing their concerns with the students and became close friends.

▶ Interview: Kim Tae-mu / Student
- "I used to think of my disability as a weakness, but seeing the teacher speak that way helped my prejudices disappear."

Han Gil-ok, a visually impaired teacher who has been on the teaching staff for over 20 years, did not initially dream of becoming a teacher.

However, after failing to find employment due to her visual impairment, she decided to stand on the teaching platform.

Knowing full well the difficulties students face, Teacher Han educates them with stricter discipline.

▶ Interview: Han Gil-ok / Grade 2 Visually Impaired Teacher
- "From my experience, you have to learn a lot more to be able to blend in with able-bodied people in society..."

▶ Standing: Choi Hee-ji / Reporter
- "There are no visible textbooks in this classroom, but we are helping them learn concepts through Braille devices."

Both teachers express their hope that their disabilities will not become a limitation.

▶ Interview: Han Gil-ok / Teacher with Grade 2 Visual Impairment

- "I hope they don't struggle because of their disability, don't give up, get a job, and become independent..."

▶ Interview: Kim Han-eum / Teacher with Grade 3 Physical Disability

- "Don't think too lowly of yourself, but work hard amidst it..."

Thanks to those who are keeping the classrooms going, the courage and hope to not give up are being conveyed.

id.title: “Jangan pernah menyerah”… Guru-guru yang mengatasi disabilitas untuk berdiri di podium [MBN News 7]
id.description:
【Komentar Pembawa Acara】

Proporsi guru penyandang disabilitas di Korea berada di kisaran 1%.

Berdiri di podium bukanlah tugas yang mudah, terutama ketika menghadapi prasangka karena disabilitas.

Hari ini (tanggal 15), dalam rangka memperingati Hari Guru, Reporter Choi Hee-ji bertemu dengan para guru penyandang disabilitas yang telah mengatasi tantangan mereka untuk menyampaikan harapan kepada murid-murid mereka.

【Reporter】

Saat kelas hampir berakhir, para siswa berkumpul di podium.

Tidak ada rasa jarak dalam cara mereka berbicara.

Guru Kim Han-eum, yang dikenal sebagai guru yang ramah, memiliki disabilitas fisik bawaan, lahir dengan empat jari di setiap tangan dan tiga jari kaki.

Meskipun sekarang ia bergaul dengan murid-muridnya seperti teman, awalnya tidak mudah.

▶ Wawancara: Kim Han-eum / Guru Kelas 3 dengan Disabilitas Fisik

- "Ada kalanya mereka memandang saya seolah-olah saya tampak seperti makhluk asing. Saya rasa awalnya saya cukup gugup ketika menerima pertanyaan terkait disabilitas saya."

Cara dia mengatasi kesulitan ini adalah dengan secara terbuka mengungkapkan disabilitasnya tanpa menyembunyikannya.

Setelah itu, mereka secara alami mulai berbagi kekhawatiran mereka dengan para siswa dan menjadi teman dekat.

▶ Wawancara: Kim Tae-mu / Siswa
- "Dulu saya menganggap disabilitas saya sebagai kelemahan, tetapi melihat guru berbicara seperti itu membantu menghilangkan prasangka saya."

Han Gil-ok, seorang guru tunanetra yang telah menjadi staf pengajar selama lebih dari 20 tahun, awalnya tidak bermimpi menjadi guru.

Namun, setelah gagal mendapatkan pekerjaan karena gangguan penglihatannya, ia memutuskan untuk terjun ke dunia pendidikan.

Mengetahui sepenuhnya kesulitan yang dihadapi siswa, Guru Han mendidik mereka dengan disiplin yang lebih ketat.

▶ Wawancara: Han Gil-ok / Guru Kelas 2 Tuna Netra
- "Dari pengalaman saya, Anda harus belajar lebih banyak agar bisa berbaur dengan orang-orang yang tidak memiliki disabilitas di masyarakat..."

▶ Berdiri: Choi Hee-ji / Reporter
- "Tidak ada buku teks yang terlihat di kelas ini, tetapi kami membantu mereka mempelajari konsep melalui perangkat Braille."

Kedua guru tersebut mengungkapkan harapan mereka agar disabilitas mereka tidak menjadi batasan.

▶ Wawancara: Han Gil-ok / Guru Kelas 2 Tuna Netra

- "Saya berharap mereka tidak kesulitan karena disabilitas mereka, jangan menyerah, dapatkan pekerjaan, dan menjadi mandiri..."

▶ Wawancara: Kim Han-eum / Guru Kelas 3 Disabilitas Fisik

- "Jangan meremehkan diri sendiri, tetapi bekerja keraslah di tengah kesulitan ini..."

Berkat mereka yang terus menjalankan kelas, keberanian dan harapan untuk tidak menyerah tersampaikan.

snippet.title: 땡볕더위와 함께 온 침묵의 살인자 '오존'…마스크 써도 못 막아 [MBN 뉴스7]
snippet.description:
【 앵커멘트 】
  한 여름 더위가 일찍 찾아온 가운데 또 다른 불청객이 나타났습니다.
  눈에 보이지는 않지만 호흡질환과 심근경색까지도 일으킬 수 있어 침묵의 살인자라고 불리는 오존인데요.
  미세먼지와 달리 마스크로도 막을 수 없습니다. 
  최하언 기자입니다. 


【 기자 】
  서울 시청역의 전광판이 오존주의보가 발령됐음을 알립니다.

▶ 인터뷰 : 김지민·이수연 / 경기도 안산 단원구
- "(서울에서 오존주의보가 발령됐거든요, 혹시 알고 계셨어요?) 아니요. 들어본 것 같은데 잘 모르겠어요."

▶ 인터뷰 : 이연우 / 대전 서구
- "(오존이 건강에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 알고 계세요?) 정확하게는 저도 잘 모르겠습니다. 건강상에 안 좋은 것들이 있다고 하면 (예보를) 더 챙겨볼 것 같습니다."

  오늘 서울 외에도 경기 북부·중부·남부, 군산, 서천에 오존농도가 짙어지면서 오존주의보가 발령됐습니다.

  지표면 오존은 자외선이 대기오염물질과 합쳐져 만들어지기 때문에 여름철에 농도가 더 짙어집니다.

  이른 더위에 올해 서울의 첫 오존주의보는 지난해보다 한 달 이상 앞선 지난달 19일에 발령됐습니다.

▶ 인터뷰(☎) : 박현주 / 국립환경과학원 연구사
- "일반적으로 높은 기온에서 휘발성 유기화물의 배출이 많아지고 이산화질소와의 광학반응으로 고농도 오존이 생성됩니다."
 
  지표면 오존은 일종의 산화물질로 체내에 들어가면 각종 염증을 유발합니다.

▶ 인터뷰 : 백수아 / 순천향대서울병원 가정의학과 교수
- "호흡기 계통 질환이 있으신 분들은 특히나 더 주의하셔야 합니다. 혈관 내피세포에 염증이 생기면서 부정맥이나 심근경색과 같은 심장 질환의 위험도 높아질 수…."

▶ 스탠딩 : 최하언 / 기자
- "오존은 자외선, 미세먼지와 다르게 마스크나 양산으로 막을 수가 없습니다. 그래서 가급적이면 외출을 자제하고, 농도가 짙을 때는 실내에서도 창문을 닫는 것이 좋습니다."

  다음 주 월요일까지 이어지는 이상더위로 전국적으로 오존농도가 짙겠고, 매우나쁨 수준을 보이는 곳이 있어 장시간 외출을 자제해야 합니다.

  MBN뉴스 최하언입니다.
[choi.haan@mbn.co.kr]

id.title: 'Ozon,' Pembunuh Diam-diam yang Datang Bersama Panas Terik... Tak Dapat Dihentikan Bahkan dengan ...
id.description:
【Komentar Pembawa Acara】

Dengan datangnya panas pertengahan musim panas lebih awal, tamu tak diinginkan lainnya telah muncul.

Itu adalah ozon, yang dikenal sebagai "pembunuh senyap" karena, meskipun tidak terlihat oleh mata telanjang, ia dapat menyebabkan penyakit pernapasan dan bahkan infark miokardium.

Tidak seperti debu halus, ozon tidak dapat diblokir bahkan oleh masker.

Laporan oleh Reporter Choi Ha-eon.

【Reporter】

Papan display elektronik di Stasiun Balai Kota Seoul mengumumkan bahwa peringatan ozon telah dikeluarkan.

▶ Wawancara: Kim Ji-min & Lee Su-yeon / Danwon-gu, Ansan, Gyeonggi-do
- "(Peringatan ozon dikeluarkan di Seoul; apakah Anda mengetahuinya?) Tidak. Saya rasa saya pernah mendengarnya, tetapi saya tidak yakin."

▶ Wawancara: Lee Yeon-woo / Seo-gu, Daejeon
- "(Apakah Anda tahu apa efek ozon terhadap kesehatan?) Saya juga tidak tahu persis. Jika ada hal-hal yang buruk bagi kesehatan, saya pikir saya akan lebih memperhatikan ramalan cuaca."

Hari ini, selain Seoul, peringatan ozon dikeluarkan di Gyeonggi-do bagian utara, tengah, dan selatan, serta Gunsan dan Seocheon, karena konsentrasi ozon meningkat.

Ozon permukaan terbentuk ketika sinar ultraviolet bergabung dengan polutan udara, sehingga konsentrasinya meningkat selama musim panas.

Karena cuaca panas yang datang lebih awal, peringatan ozon pertama Seoul tahun ini dikeluarkan pada tanggal 19 bulan lalu, lebih dari sebulan lebih awal dari tahun lalu.

▶ Wawancara (☎): Park Hyun-ju / Peneliti, Institut Penelitian Lingkungan Nasional

- "Secara umum, pada suhu tinggi, emisi senyawa organik volatil meningkat, dan konsentrasi ozon yang tinggi dihasilkan melalui reaksi fotokimia dengan nitrogen dioksida."

Ozon permukaan adalah jenis zat pengoksidasi yang menyebabkan berbagai peradangan ketika masuk ke dalam tubuh.

▶ Wawancara: Baek Su-a / Profesor, Departemen Kedokteran Keluarga, Rumah Sakit Universitas Soonchunhyang Seoul

- "Mereka yang menderita penyakit pernapasan perlu sangat berhati-hati. Karena peradangan terjadi pada sel endotel vaskular, risiko penyakit jantung seperti aritmia atau infark miokard juga dapat meningkat..."

▶ Berdiri: Choi Ha-eon / Reporter

- "Tidak seperti sinar ultraviolet atau debu halus, ozon tidak dapat diblokir oleh masker atau payung. Oleh karena itu, disarankan untuk sebisa mungkin menghindari keluar rumah, dan menutup jendela bahkan di dalam ruangan ketika konsentrasinya tinggi."

Karena gelombang panas abnormal yang berlanjut hingga Senin depan, konsentrasi ozon akan tinggi di seluruh negeri, dan dengan beberapa daerah menunjukkan tingkat "sangat buruk", Anda harus menghindari keluar rumah dalam waktu lama.

Ini Choi Ha-eon dari MBN News.

en-US.title: 'Ozone,' the Silent Killer Arriving with the Scorching Heat... Cannot Be Stopped Even by Masks [M...
en-US.description:
【 Anchor Comment 】

With the midsummer heat arriving early, another unwelcome guest has appeared.

It is ozone, known as the "silent killer" because, although invisible to the naked eye, it can cause respiratory diseases and even myocardial infarction.

Unlike fine dust, it cannot be blocked even by a mask.

Reporter Choi Ha-eon reports.

【 Reporter 】

The electronic display board at Seoul City Hall Station announces that an ozone advisory has been issued.

▶ Interview: Kim Ji-min & Lee Su-yeon / Danwon-gu, Ansan, Gyeonggi-do
- "(An ozone advisory was issued in Seoul; were you aware of it?) No. I think I heard about it, but I'm not sure."

▶ Interview: Lee Yeon-woo / Seo-gu, Daejeon
- "(Do you know what effect ozone has on health?) I don't know exactly either. If there are things that are bad for health, I think I would pay closer attention to the forecast."

Today, in addition to Seoul, ozone advisories were issued in northern, central, and southern Gyeonggi-do, as well as Gunsan and Seocheon, as ozone concentrations intensified.

Ground-level ozone is formed when ultraviolet rays combine with air pollutants, so its concentration increases during the summer.

Due to the early onset of hot weather, Seoul's first ozone advisory of the year was issued on the 19th of last month, more than a month earlier than last year.

▶ Interview (☎): Park Hyun-ju / Researcher, National Institute of Environmental Research

- "Generally, at high temperatures, the emission of volatile organic compounds increases, and high concentrations of ozone are generated through photochemical reactions with nitrogen dioxide."

Ground-level ozone is a type of oxidizing agent that causes various inflammations when it enters the body.

▶ Interview: Baek Su-a / Professor, Department of Family Medicine, Soonchunhyang University Seoul Hospital

- "Those with respiratory diseases need to be especially careful. As inflammation occurs in vascular endothelial cells, the risk of heart diseases such as arrhythmia or myocardial infarction can also increase..."

▶ Standing: Choi Ha-eon / Reporter

- "Unlike ultraviolet rays or fine dust, ozone cannot be blocked by masks or parasols. Therefore, it is advisable to refrain from going outside as much as possible, and to keep windows closed even indoors when concentrations are high."

Due to the abnormal heat wave continuing until next Monday, ozone concentrations will be high nationwide, and with some areas showing "very poor" levels, you should refrain from going out for extended periods.

This is Choi Ha-eon from MBN News.

[choi.haan@mbn.co.kr]

snippet.title: [기동취재] 출소자 만나보니 "약 보면 가슴부터 두근"…거주형 시설은 '걸음마' [MBN 뉴스7]
snippet.description:
【 앵커멘트 】
  교도소에 있을 때는 자의 반 타의 반으로 치료가 잘 되지만 문제는 출소 이후입니다.
  MBN 취재진이 출소자를 직접 만나보니 마약의 유혹은 여전히 강력했습니다. 
  이 때문에 집이 아닌 전문시설에 거주하며 치료 받는 게 효과적이지만 아직은 걸음마 단계입니다.
  기동취재, 이어서 현지호 기자입니다.


【 기자 】
  거실에 모여 마약과의 이별을 다짐하는 입소자들.

  마약 투약으로 처벌받은 60대 남성은 마약을 끊은 지 반 년이 됐지만 아직 마약이란 단어만 떠올려도 심장이 뛴다고 고백합니다.

▶ 인터뷰 : 별명 '별하나' / 단약 5개월 차
- "(약물을) 제 앞에 갖다 놓으면 제 가슴이 두근거리고 그 약물을 할 수 있을지 없을지는 확실히 장담을 못 하겠어요."

  복역 뒤에도 다시 약물에 손 대기를 반복하다 결국 거주형 재활시설에 들어갔습니다.

▶ 인터뷰 : 별명 '별하나' / 단약 5개월 차
- "단약은 절대 혼자서는 할 수 없다고 생각합니다. 여기에서 회복해서 제가 올바른 성장을 하면 다시 가족들하고 만날 수 있다는 그런 희망을 갖고…."

  중독 치료에는 지속적으로 단약을 할 수 있는 거주형 재활시설이 가장 효과적입니다.

  교도소 재활 치료를 마치고 출소하면 거주형 재활시설로 옮겨 마약 중단 방법을 더 훈련받고 이후 자발적 관리에 나서는 식입니다.

  하지만 거주형 재활시설은 전국에 단 네 곳으로 모두 민간 시설입니다.

▶ 인터뷰 : 한부식 / 거주형 재활 시설 리본하우스 원장
- "예산이 제일 큰 문제예요. 우리 직원 월급은, 월급은 줄 수 있어야 되잖아요. 후원금도 올해까지 받고 나면 내년에는 이제 끝인데…."

  정부 산하 한국마약퇴치운동본부 연구용역 보고서에서도 민간 운영의 한계를 지적하며, 정부 주도의 시설 설치·운영 기준 확립이 시급하다고 언급했습니다.

  재범률이 높은 마약 범죄 특성상 대규모 예산 등의 과감한 정책이 필요한 때라는 지적입니다.

  MBN뉴스 현지호입니다. [hyun.jiho@mbn.co.kr]

id.title: [Laporan Langsung] Bertemu dengan Narapidana yang Dibebaskan: "Jantung Berdebar Saat Melihat Obat...
id.description:
【Komentar Pembawa Acara】

Saat di penjara, pengobatan efektif, sebagian karena pilihan dan sebagian karena keadaan, tetapi masalah muncul setelah pembebasan.

Ketika reporter MBN bertemu langsung dengan para narapidana yang telah dibebaskan, mereka menemukan bahwa godaan narkoba tetap kuat.

Oleh karena itu, menerima pengobatan sambil tinggal di fasilitas khusus daripada di rumah lebih efektif, tetapi pendekatan ini masih dalam tahap awal.

Laporan Keliling berlanjut dengan Reporter Hyun Ji-ho.

【Reporter】

Para narapidana berkumpul di ruang tamu, berjanji untuk meninggalkan narkoba.

Seorang pria berusia 60-an, yang dihukum karena penggunaan narkoba, mengaku bahwa meskipun sudah setengah tahun sejak ia berhenti, jantungnya masih berdebar kencang hanya dengan menyebutkan kata "narkoba."

▶ Wawancara: Julukan 'Byeolhana' / 5 Bulan Bebas Narkoba

- "Jika (narkoba) diletakkan di depan saya, jantung saya berdebar kencang, dan saya tidak dapat memastikan apakah saya akan mampu menggunakannya atau tidak."

Setelah berulang kali kambuh menggunakan narkoba bahkan setelah menjalani hukumannya, ia akhirnya masuk ke fasilitas rehabilitasi rawat inap.

** ▶ Wawancara: Julukan 'Byeolhana' / 5 Bulan Bebas Narkoba

- "Saya percaya bahwa berhenti menggunakan narkoba sama sekali tidak mungkin dilakukan sendirian. Saya tetap berharap bahwa jika saya pulih di sini dan berkembang dengan baik, saya dapat bertemu keluarga saya lagi..."

Fasilitas rehabilitasi rawat inap, di mana individu dapat mempertahankan pantang secara konsisten, adalah yang paling efektif untuk pengobatan kecanduan.

Prosesnya melibatkan penyelesaian perawatan rehabilitasi di penjara, dibebaskan, dan kemudian dipindahkan ke fasilitas rawat inap untuk menerima pelatihan lebih lanjut tentang cara berhenti menggunakan narkoba sebelum terlibat dalam manajemen sukarela.

Namun, hanya ada empat fasilitas rehabilitasi rawat inap di seluruh negeri, yang semuanya dimiliki swasta.

▶ Wawancara: Han Bu-sik / Direktur Reborn House, Fasilitas Rehabilitasi Perumahan

- "Anggaran adalah masalah terbesar. Kita perlu bisa membayar gaji staf kita, Anda tahu. Sedangkan untuk donasi, kita hanya akan menerimanya hingga akhir tahun ini, dan tahun depan akan menjadi yang terakhir..."

Sebuah laporan penelitian yang ditugaskan oleh Markas Besar Kampanye Anti-Narkoba Korea yang berafiliasi dengan pemerintah juga menunjukkan keterbatasan operasi swasta dan menyatakan bahwa penetapan standar yang dipimpin pemerintah untuk instalasi dan pengoperasian fasilitas tersebut sangat mendesak.

Disebutkan bahwa mengingat tingkat residivisme yang tinggi yang menjadi ciri khas kejahatan narkoba, sudah saatnya untuk kebijakan yang berani, seperti anggaran skala besar.

Ini adalah Hyun Ji-ho dari MBN News. [hyun.jiho@mbn.co.kr]

en-US.title: [On-the-Spot Report] Meeting a Released Prisoner: "Heart Pounds at the Seeing of Medicine"... Res...
en-US.description:
【 Anchor Comment 】

While in prison, treatment is effective, partly by choice and partly by circumstance, but the problem arises after release.

When MBN reporters met with released prisoners in person, they found that the temptation of drugs remained powerful.

For this reason, receiving treatment while residing in a specialized facility rather than at home is effective, but this approach is still in its infancy.

Mobile Reporting continues with Reporter Hyun Ji-ho.

【 Reporter 】

Inmates gathered in the living room, vowing to part ways with drugs.

A man in his 60s, who was punished for drug use, confesses that although it has been half a year since he quit, his heart still races at the mere mention of the word "drugs."

▶ Interview: Nickname 'Byeolhana' / 5 Months Sober

- "If (the drugs) are placed in front of me, my heart pounds, and I cannot guarantee for sure whether or not I will be able to use them."

After repeatedly relapsing into drugs even after serving his sentence, he eventually entered a residential rehabilitation facility.

** ▶ Interview: Nickname 'Byeolhana' / 5 Months Sobriety

- "I believe that quitting drugs is absolutely impossible to do alone. I hold onto the hope that if I recover here and grow properly, I can meet my family again..."

Residential rehabilitation facilities, where individuals can maintain abstinence consistently, are the most effective for addiction treatment.

The process involves completing rehabilitation treatment in prison, being released, and then transferring to a residential facility to receive further training on how to stop drugs before engaging in voluntary management.

However, there are only four residential rehabilitation facilities nationwide, all of which are privately owned.

▶ Interview: Han Bu-sik / Director of Reborn House, a Residential Rehabilitation Facility

- "The budget is the biggest problem. We need to be able to pay our staff's salaries, you know. As for donations, we will only receive them until the end of this year, and next year will be the last..."

A research report commissioned by the government-affiliated Korea Anti-Drug Campaign Headquarters also pointed out the limitations of private operation and stated that establishing government-led standards for the installation and operation of such facilities is urgent.

It is pointed out that given the high recidivism rate characteristic of drug crimes, it is time for bold policies, such as large-scale budgets.

This is Hyun Ji-ho from MBN News. [hyun.jiho@mbn.co.kr]

- "단약은 절대 혼자서는 할 수 없다고 생각합니다. 여기에서 회복해서 제가 올바른 성장을 하면 다시 가족들하고 만날 수 있다는 그런 희망을 갖고…."

  중독 치료에는 지속적으로 단약을 할 수 있는 거주형 재활시설이 가장 효과적입니다.

  교도소 재활 치료를 마치고 출소하면 거주형 재활시설로 옮겨 마약 중단 방법을 더 훈련받고 이후 자발적 관리에 나서는 식입니다.

  하지만 거주형 재활시설은 전국에 단 네 곳으로 모두 민간 시설입니다.

▶ 인터뷰 : 한부식 / 거주형 재활 시설 리본하우스 원장
- "예산이 제일 큰 문제예요. 우리 직원 월급은, 월급은 줄 수 있어야 되잖아요. 후원금도 올해까지 받고 나면 내년에는 이제 끝인데…."

  정부 산하 한국마약퇴치운동본부 연구용역 보고서에서도 민간 운영의 한계를 지적하며, 정부 주도의 시설 설치·운영 기준 확립이 시급하다고 언급했습니다.

  재범률이 높은 마약 범죄 특성상 대규모 예산 등의 과감한 정책이 필요한 때라는 지적입니다.
